description: Receive Weather Satellite Data with the USB Nooelec RTL-SDR v5
pipeline_template: rtl_fm -f {frequency} -M fm -s 40k -r 32k -g 45 | sox -t raw -r 32k -e signed-integer -b 16 -c 1 - -t raw -r 48k - | ffmpeg -y -f s16le -ar 48k -ac 1 -i pipe:0 -f s16le -ar 48k -ac 2 pipe:1 >> {fifo_pipe}
